reason: Both satisfy all hard requirements, but Response B resolves the no-decommission-in-final-migration-phase constraint more cleanly by giving decommissioning its own explicit fourth phase (0% users) rather than folding a caveat into Phase 3's prose, and its risk set is more specific and complete (tokenization, tax-engine cross-validation, rollback SLA) with more precise numeric entry/exit criteria at each stage.
